meta.name: pestel-analysis
meta.description: Analyze political, economic, social, technological, environmental, and legal forces. Use when external market shifts could materially affect a product, roadmap, or strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析外部六维环境变化，辅助产品战略决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估宏观环境对产品的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze six external forces to guide product strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate macro-environmental impacts on your product

howto.what: 它会根据你指定的产品、市场或项目，系统分析政治、经济、社会、技术、环境、法律六大外部因素，并输出机会、威胁与战略建议报告。
howto.when: 当你需要评估外部市场变化对产品或战略的影响时，例如进入新市场、进行年度规划或风险评估。

say.text: 帮我做个PESTEL分析，分析我们的AI发票工具如何进军欧盟市场。
say.note: 它会按步骤生成六类因素分析。

say.text: 分析当前经济形势对SaaS产品定价策略的影响。
say.note: 它会聚焦经济因素，给出具体影响和建议。

howto.what_en: It systematically analyzes political, economic, social, technological, environmental, and legal factors for your product or project, producing a report with opportunities, threats, and strategic recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to assess external market shifts affecting your product or strategy, e.g., entering new markets, annual planning, or risk assessment.

say_en.text: Perform a PESTEL analysis for our AI invoice tool's EU market entry.
say_en.note: It will step through all six factor categories.

say_en.text: Analyze how the current economy impacts our SaaS pricing strategy.
say_en.note: It focuses on economic factors with specific impacts and recommendations.
